answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 4715 Country: India Title: I have been suffering from neurogenic pain in my lower par of body. I request u to pls tell me any dua which can help me to get rid of this pain. Question: Assalmu-alaikum. I have been suffering from neurogenic pain in my lower par of body. I request u to pls tell me any dua which can help me to get rid of this pain. Answer ID: 4715 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1332/339=H/1429) Recite سورۃ الم نشرح 21 times with durood 11 times before and after, blow on your hands and wipe the hands over body. Also, blow on water and drink it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
